item.text: Exit code zero only shows that the child process ended without reporting an operating-system-level failure; it does not prove that the protocol operation completed successfully. A Rust process adapter must also require a successful terminal event to distinguish confirmed completion from a truncated stream, premature shutdown, or protocol-level failure.
